hints.title: Successive Modulo Decrement
hints.text: For any positive integer x > 1, x % (x - 1) is always equal to 1.

hints.title: Cascade of Predecessors
hints.text: Starting with n, the number n - 1 is placed on the board the next day, which in turn causes n - 2 to be placed, and so forth down to 2.

hints.title: Boundary Case for Unity
hints.text: If n is 1, no smaller positive integer can be added, yielding 1. For any n > 1, all numbers from 2 to n appear, giving n - 1.

hints.title: Board Population Formula Implementation

complexity.notes: Closed-form deduction evaluated in constant time.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Simulating 10^9 days directly is computationally impossible.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Identifies that x % (x - 1) == 1 guarantees all numbers from 2 through n are added.
